card.label: Card plan as is
card.desc: Every pass. Market buy. 50% sells at 2x, 40% at 3x, 10% trails 40%. Stop under the 2-hour low, or 30%.

entry_limit.label: Entry plan only, limit buy
entry_limit.desc: Only passes with a suggested entry. Limit buy at support, good for 12 hours. Card exits.

entry_market.label: Entry plan only, market buy
entry_market.desc: Only passes with a suggested entry, but bought at once. Card exits.

nochase.label: No chasers
nochase.desc: Skips coins up 50%+ in the last 2 hours or falling in the last hour. Market buy. 50% at 1.5x, 40% at 2x, 10% trails 30%.

freshdip.label: Fresh dip
freshdip.desc: Fresh graduates with a suggested entry. Limit buy at support. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 6 hours.

quick.label: Quick flip
quick.desc: Every pass. Market buy. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 4 hours.

big.label: Big coins (unproven)
big.desc: Safe coins the scanner rejects only for a market cap over $5M. Market buy. 50% at 1.3x, 50% at 1.5x, stop 15%, out after 48 hours.

surv_quick.label: Survivor quick
surv_quick.desc: Coins that already lasted 6 to 48 hours and held up. Market buy. Sell all at 1.25x, stop 15%, out after 12 hours.

surv_swing.label: Survivor swing
surv_swing.desc: The same coins. Market buy. 50% sells at 1.5x, 30% at 2x, 20% trails 30%. Stop 25%, out after 48 hours.

curve_run.label: Curve run
curve_run.desc: Coins still on the pump.fun curve, 30-80% full. Market buy. Sell all at the price the curve has when 90% full, stop 30%, out after 90 minutes.

curve_quick.label: Curve quick
curve_quick.desc: The same curve coins. Market buy. Sell all at 1.5x, stop 25%, out after 30 minutes.

trail_tight.label: v2 Tight trail
trail_tight.desc: Coins not falling in the last hour. Market buy. Stop 5% under the buy. Once up 20%, a 15% trailing stop takes over. Out after 1 hour.

trail_pool.label: v2 Trail, big pool
trail_pool.desc: Pool $20K+ and not falling in the last hour. Market buy. Stop 10%. Once up 20%, a 15% trailing stop takes over. Out after 1 hour.

be_2x.label: v2 2x with break-even
be_2x.desc: Pool $20K+ and not falling in the last hour. Market buy. Stop 15%, moved up to the buy price once up 30%. Sell all at 2x. Out after 4 hours.

sell30.label: v2 Sell all at +30%
sell30.desc: Rainer's idea. Pool $20K+ and not falling in the last hour. Market buy. Sell everything at +30%. Stop 10%. Out after 4 hours.

surv_2x.label: v2 Survivor 2x
surv_2x.desc: Survivor coins. Market buy. Stop 25%, moved up to the buy price once up 30%. Sell all at 2x. Out after 4 hours. Based on only 11 trades.

trail_tight_s15.label: v2 Tight trail, stops fill 15% worse
trail_tight_s15.desc: Twin of v2 Tight trail: the same trades, but every stop or trailing-stop sale fills 15% worse than its price (Tight trail assumes 10%).

trail_tight_s20.label: v2 Tight trail, stops fill 20% worse
trail_tight_s20.desc: Twin of v2 Tight trail: the same trades, but every stop or trailing-stop sale fills 20% worse than its price (Jupiter's default stop slippage is up to 20%).

famous_exact.label: v2 Famous name (exact)
famous_exact.desc: Coins whose name or ticker IS a famous brand, person or meme (YouTube, NASA, MrBeast, FOMO) and not falling in the last hour. Same exits as Tight trail: stop 5%, 15% trail once up 20%, out after 1 hour.

famous_any.label: v2 Famous name (anywhere)
famous_any.desc: Coins with a famous term somewhere in the name (Flying Tesla Roadster, Trump in Batter), not falling in the last hour. Same exits as Tight trail. The review says these lose; this checks it.

meta_first.label: Meta burst: first coin
meta_first.desc: The first coin created in a name burst (4+ coins by 3+ creators with the same new name within 15 minutes). Market buy. Stop 25%. Once up 30%, a 25% trailing stop takes over. Out after 2 hours.

meta_leader.label: Meta burst: most buyers
meta_leader.desc: The coin with the most buyers in a name burst (often, but not always, the first one). Same exits: stop 25%, 25% trail once up 30%, out after 2 hours.

trail_tight_run.label: v2 Tight trail, half runs
trail_tight_run.desc: The same buys as v2 Tight trail. Stop 5%. Once up 20%: half sells on a 15% trailing stop like Tight trail, the other half keeps running on a 30% trailing stop with no 1-hour time stop (3 days at most).

famous_exact_run.label: v2 Famous name (exact), half runs
famous_exact_run.desc: The same buys as v2 Famous name (exact). Stop 5%. Once up 20%: half sells on a 15% trailing stop, the other half keeps running on a 30% trailing stop with no 1-hour time stop (3 days at most).

trail_tight_chain.label: v2 Tight trail, real chain price
trail_tight_chain.desc: Real-money version: the same buys as "v2 Tight trail", but at the on-chain price the live feed saw 1 second after the paper buy. Every sell is priced from the live pool: targets at their price, stops and trailing stops 2 seconds after the price crosses them, minus the price impact of the whole position and the pool fee.
